name: divergent_haplotype
headline_stat: fraction of H2-origin reads successfully mapped (sensitivity) and correctly placed

construction.description: Take a 50 Mb slice of human chr1 as haplotype H1. Derive H2 by injecting SNPs and short indels at a target divergence rate (1-8%), well beyond human ~0.1% heterozygosity. Simulate reads from a diploid {H1, H2} mixture. Map only against H1.

simulation.command: dwgsim -1 150 -2 150 -C 30 -z {rng_seed} ../reference/h1.fasta reads_h1 && dwgsim -1 150 -2 150 -C 30 -z {rng_seed} ../reference/h2.fasta reads_h2 && cat reads_h1.bwa.read1.fastq.gz reads_h2.bwa.read1.fastq.gz > reads_1.fastq.gz && cat reads_h1.bwa.read2.fastq.gz reads_h2.bwa.read2.fastq.gz > reads_2.fastq.gz
simulation.notes: Simulate equal coverage from both haplotypes. Map mixed read set against H1 only. H2-origin reads are the diagnostic signal.

sweep.notes: Each divergence level produces separate H2. Run construction and simulation for each level separately.

truth.eval_notes: H2-origin reads mapped to H1: measure sensitivity (fraction mapped) and soft-clip rate vs. divergence. Track reference bias at heterozygous sites in the pileup.
